rendering.n8: the stack of 9,133 rows rendered as its envelope (fill_betweenx with step='mid': one horizontal band per row between its drawn lower and upper end, no interpolation between neighbouring rows), which is what 9,133 segments of sub-point thickness would show

white_gaps.meaning: a white gap inside a stack is a row whose interval starts above q = 1 (lower end of kind root); such rows are grouped because rows with equal upper ends are sub-sorted by lower end
